turns.input: *From the alley mouth, Nicco sees Garrick Vole swing his hatchet at Hollis Brenn, a grown man cornered against the wall. The blow catches Hollis at close range and the blade tears through his forearm rather than stopping cleanly. Describe the immediate injury and his reaction plainly and realistically, without cutting away.*
turns.draft:
The hatchet blade strikes Hollis's raised left forearm with a hard, wet thud. It bites deep into the meat below the elbow, gouging a ragged, gaping furrow through flesh and cloth before tearing loose under the force of the swing. Dark blood immediately wells in a thick wash across his pale skin, dripping heavily off his knuckles into the dirt.

Hollis releases a breathless, strangled gasp, his knees buckling until his back slams hard into the rough wall behind him. He clutches his wounded arm tightly against his chest with his good hand, his fingers slipping in the fresh blood as he trembles violently. "Wait—gods, wait," he wheezes out, his face draining of color as his eyes fix wide and glassy on the blade.

Garrick lowers the short-hafted hatchet slightly, his knuckles white around the handle as red spatters smear the iron head. He steps in closer, blocking any path out toward the passage mouth, his chest rising and falling in steady, heavy breaths.
